units.name: Department of Management Science and Engineering
units.evidence: Official Beihang School of Economics and Management page names this department, says it offers PhD programmes, and identifies operations research and industrial engineering among its research areas. The qualifying Management Science wording occurs in the department title.

units.name: Department of Statistics and Operations Research
units.evidence: Fresh full official School of Mathematical Sciences page explicitly lists Department of Statistics and Operations Research as one of four actual departments. The school separately states it has Mathematics and Statistics doctoral programmes; departmental hosting of either exact degree is not expressly mapped and is not inferred.

units.name: Department of Behavioral and Operations Management
units.evidence: Current official SEM organizational structure lists this formal department separately from Management Science and Engineering. Its linked department page, although published in 2016, explicitly titles Behavioral and Operations Management and describes two doctoral programmes. No additional independent current degree route inferred from that older description.

decisions.reason: Reported doctorate institution discovery assertion only; no department is asserted and no individual degree is verified.

A 2016 Behavioral department profile says formerly Management Science and Engineering, while current organization lists both; precise historical split/rename is unresolved and no duplicate current doctoral route is created.

Other Beihang school/unit inventories remain partial; two imported OM person doctorates are discovery only.
